title: Toone
lede: Toone is a Mac app for building repeatable workflows in plain language, where each step is either a ChatGPT or Claude chat thread or a fixed automation that runs without AI.

points: Each node in a routine is an agent thread on a chosen model, or a deterministic step that spends no tokens.
Agents build the routine, create specialist agents to run it, schedule it and refine it across runs.
Routines can be paused and resumed mid-run, and edited while they are running.
The app also bundles live sharing, meeting notes, a calendar, quick capture, Git and MCP connections for research and SEO.
Explore Routines is a marketplace for publishing and selling routines that work.

sections.text: Small teams and solo builders juggling outreach, content, SEO and support who want scheduled routines with consistent output rather than a prompt on a timer.
The launch comment offers the Toone Pro Lifetime plan at 80% off with a launch-week code.
